title: A Digital Twin Framework for Precision Neuromusculoskeletal Health Care
human_nms_modeling: a conceptual neural–muscle–skeletal and tissue hierarchy
sensorimotor_control: the perception–action loop is specified but not implemented
rehabilitation_relevance: high as a research agenda, untested as rehabilitation technology
subject_specific_validation: none
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It contributes a systems architecture for future embodied agents, not empirical embodied intelligence.

title: Digital twin systems for musculoskeletal applications
human_nms_modeling: surveys multibody, FE and AI components
sensorimotor_control: no implemented policy, action loop or environment interaction
rehabilitation_relevance: medium, through orthopedic use cases rather than tested rehabilitation
subject_specific_validation: reviewed studies are heterogeneous
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It maps enabling components but does not establish an embodied NMS system.

title: Human digital twins in sports and rehabilitation
human_nms_modeling: audits heterogeneous human digital-twin representations
sensorimotor_control: no implemented sensorimotor agent
rehabilitation_relevance: high at field level, but no system-level rehabilitation test
subject_specific_validation: not applicable
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: Its real contribution is an audit showing that monitoring interfaces are often mislabeled as twins; it is contextual evidence, not an embodied-AI method.

title: Neuromusculoskeletal modeling from neural command
human_nms_modeling: an EMG-to-activation-to-muscle-force-to-joint-moment body model
sensorimotor_control: offline neural-to-mechanical inference with no action or environmental feedback
rehabilitation_relevance: indirect but foundational for rehabilitation and assistance
subject_specific_validation: subject-specific calibration in human movement data
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It provides a physiologically interpretable body model for an embodied agent, but no embodied controller.

title: OpenSim
human_nms_modeling: a general musculoskeletal dynamics and simulation platform
sensorimotor_control: supports optimal control and simulation, but the paper itself does not implement a learning agent or adaptive loop
subject_specific_validation: models can be scaled to subjects, but validation is application dependent
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: OpenSim is body-model infrastructure; using it alone is not an embodied-AI contribution.

title: CEINMS Toolbox
human_nms_modeling: a calibrated EMG-informed/assisted NMS body model
sensorimotor_control: estimates internal state offline; no agent action or environment loop
rehabilitation_relevance: high as a mechanistic rehabilitation substrate
subject_specific_validation: subject-specific calibration is central, while internal-force truth remains indirect
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: CEINMS is a strong physiological substrate, not an embodied-intelligence system by itself.

title: Hybrid EMG-informed NMS modeling
human_nms_modeling: a hybrid EMG-informed NMS representation
sensorimotor_control: infers latent excitations and joint moments offline without selecting actions
subject_specific_validation: healthy subject-specific models with limited sample diversity
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It advances neural-state completion for body modeling, not embodied control.

title: Real-time EMG-driven NMS modeling
human_nms_modeling: a real-time subject-specific EMG-driven lower-limb NMS model
sensorimotor_control: continuous sensing updates the body state, but the evaluated paper does not close an action–environment loop
human_robot_interaction: no physical robot in this study
rehabilitation_relevance: high as the state-estimation layer for assistance
subject_specific_validation: subject-specific real-time validation including unseen tasks/DOF
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is a nearest real-time body-state estimator; embodied intelligence begins only when its estimate changes action and is evaluated in interaction.

title: Subject-specific versus generic MSK modeling
human_nms_modeling: generic and MRI-personalized muscle geometry/parameters
sensorimotor_control: no perception–action loop
subject_specific_validation: strong subject-specific anatomical comparison
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It validates why individual body structure can matter, but contributes no embodied agent or controller.

title: Wrapping-surface personalization
human_nms_modeling: personalized muscle wrapping inside an EMG-driven NMS model
sensorimotor_control: offline calibration and prediction only
subject_specific_validation: subject-specific geometry is evaluated without direct internal-load ground truth
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It improves the fidelity/efficiency of the body model rather than embodied intelligence.

title: Calibration of EMD and maximum isometric force
human_nms_modeling: an EMG-driven calibrated NMS model used to test parameter sensitivity
sensorimotor_control: no action loop
subject_specific_validation: 28-person calibration sensitivity rather than functional individualized control
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: Its main Embodied-AI value is a warning: controllers must not treat a good output fit as proof of a correct internal body state.

title: RL personalization of EMG-driven models
human_nms_modeling: a subject-adapted upper-limb NMS mapping
sensorimotor_control: an RL personalization policy supports online virtual-hand posture control
rehabilitation_relevance: medium; amputee relevance is demonstrated only in a virtual task
subject_specific_validation: personalized models are tested across users including one amputee
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is a genuine embodied-control precursor because sensing changes action in a virtual body, but it lacks physical prosthesis and longitudinal validation.

title: NMSM Pipeline
human_nms_modeling: a patient-specific joint–muscle–tendon–neural-control model
sensorimotor_control: optimizes counterfactual actions in simulation but has no sensing-driven agent loop
rehabilitation_relevance: high conceptual relevance to post-stroke rehabilitation
subject_specific_validation: one patient-specific use case with model-internal outcome
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is a strong patient-conditioned planning substrate, not validated embodied intelligence until predicted actions are executed and measured.

title: Synergy-informed NMS modeling in cerebral palsy
human_nms_modeling: a synergy-informed patient NMS model for knee contact force
sensorimotor_control: offline sensor-to-state inference without action selection
subject_specific_validation: six participants with patient-specific modeling but indirect force truth
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It reduces sensing burden for a decision-relevant body state; embodied-AI contribution remains incomplete without a control or feedback loop.

title: Patient-specific MSK-FE rehabilitation pipeline
human_nms_modeling: a patient-specific whole-body NMS model coupled to knee FE tissue mechanics
sensorimotor_control: compares candidate activities offline rather than adapting action online
rehabilitation_relevance: high, because rehabilitation activities are the evaluated context
subject_specific_validation: 15 knee-OA patients with personalized models but no prospective prescription
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It advances patient-specific body–tissue consequence modeling, not embodied sensorimotor intelligence.

title: Personalized real-time Achilles multiscale model
human_nms_modeling: a personalized NMS-to-tendon-FE surrogate
sensorimotor_control: physical sensing updates Achilles strain and provides live smartphone feedback, but behavioral adaptation to that feedback is not evaluated
subject_specific_validation: single-subject personalized real-time demonstration
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It approaches embodied feedback by linking action to estimated tissue consequence, but lacks an experimentally closed behavior–feedback loop.

title: Continuous calibration for exoskeleton control
human_nms_modeling: an autodifferentiable NMS body model updated online
sensorimotor_control: continuous model adaptation is coupled to exoskeleton control
rehabilitation_relevance: potentially high but clinical/longitudinal evidence is limited
subject_specific_validation: short-session subject-specific calibration; full-text evidence remains limited
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is strong embodied NMS control evidence, but not yet patient-grounded longitudinal co-adaptation.

title: Benchmarking personalized hand models
human_nms_modeling: alternative subject-specific hand NMS models
sensorimotor_control: no action loop
subject_specific_validation: MRI and fine-wire EMG provide unusually strong validation
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It contributes a crucial body-model validity benchmark and shows that predictive accuracy can hide anatomically false embodiment.

title: Imaging-assisted personalized lumbar robot rehabilitation
human_nms_modeling: a sparse-MRI-personalized lumbar muscle model
sensorimotor_control: the personalized model selects robot trajectory/force and measured EMG evaluates the physical response
rehabilitation_relevance: direct and high, though recovery outcomes are absent
subject_specific_validation: four-human personalized model-to-robot validation
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is a strong physical embodied-NMS example: an individualized body model changes robot action, but acute EMG targeting is not longitudinal rehabilitation efficacy.

title: Personalized cartilage mechanics under gait biofeedback
human_nms_modeling: generic and MRI-personalized knee models under an intervention condition
sensorimotor_control: the model evaluates responses but does not select or adapt feedback
human_robot_interaction: human biofeedback context, not model-controlled HRI
rehabilitation_relevance: high as a cost–benefit test for personalization
subject_specific_validation: patient-specific models compared against generic models
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It clarifies when anatomical personalization changes an intervention conclusion, but is not an embodied controller.

title: In Vivo Neuromechanics
human_nms_modeling: a motor-neuron-to-muscle-force-to-joint-moment chain
sensorimotor_control: neural state is decoded into mechanics without environmental action
subject_specific_validation: subject-specific model with direct motor-unit observations
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It supplies a high-value neural observation layer for embodied NMS agents, but no agent–environment loop.

title: Motor-neuron interface after targeted muscle reinnervation
human_nms_modeling: spinal motor-neuron discharge as the biological control source
sensorimotor_control: offline decoding maps neural activity to intended commands, without device-in-the-loop evaluation
subject_specific_validation: six high-level amputees; no subject-specific mechanical body model
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It advances biologically grounded sensing, not embodied intelligence until decoded intent controls a physical device with feedback.

title: Neuro-Musculoskeletal Mapping for Man-Machine Interfacing
human_nms_modeling: a calibrated neural-drive-to-wrist-mechanics map
sensorimotor_control: closes an offline computational mapping but not a physical action loop
subject_specific_validation: person-specific calibration in intact and amputee data
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is a sensorimotor mapping component; embodiment remains computational because environment interaction and device feedback are absent.

title: Intramuscular EMG-driven MSK modeling
human_nms_modeling: an iEMG-driven personalized gait NMS model
sensorimotor_control: sensing estimates assistive joint moments, but no device action is tested
subject_specific_validation: four healthy and three incomplete-SCI participants with subject-specific modeling
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It validates a potential long-term neural sensor for an embodied controller, not the controller itself.

title: Perspective on predictive gait simulations
human_nms_modeling: reviews gait models and optimal-control assumptions
sensorimotor_control: no implemented embodied agent
subject_specific_validation: not applicable
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It sets the falsification bar for predictive embodied models but contributes no new agent, body, sensing or interaction system.

title: Deep RL for neuromechanical locomotion control
human_nms_modeling: a simulated muscle-actuated locomotor body
sensorimotor_control: policy and environment form a closed simulated sensorimotor loop
subject_specific_validation: no human subject-specific binding
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is genuine simulated NMS embodied intelligence and a strong control baseline, but reward success does not establish biological or patient validity.

title: MotorNet
human_nms_modeling: differentiable biomechanical effectors
sensorimotor_control: neural controllers act through a body in a task environment
subject_specific_validation: no patient binding
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: MotorNet is a strong experimental sandbox for embodied sensorimotor hypotheses, not a human-validated NMS system.

title: Curriculum RL for musculoskeletal skills
human_nms_modeling: a 39-muscle hand interacting with Baoding balls
sensorimotor_control: a policy learns contact-rich control and is probed for synergy structure
subject_specific_validation: no subject-specific validation
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It contributes embodied motor-learning evidence and challenges naive low-dimensional synergy interpretations, but remains simulator-specific.

title: Latent exploration for RL
human_nms_modeling: a high-dimensional muscle-actuated simulated body
sensorimotor_control: learned latent actions improve policy exploration in closed-loop tasks
subject_specific_validation: no human binding
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: Its contribution is algorithmic efficiency for embodied control; it does not validate physiology, patients or physical transfer.

title: DynSyn
human_nms_modeling: a muscle-actuated body with state-dependent action representation
sensorimotor_control: dynamic synergies adapt policy action to state and task
rehabilitation_relevance: medium as a possible impairment/coordination model
subject_specific_validation: no subject-specific validation
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It advances adaptive action representation in embodied agents, but its physiological and rehabilitation meaning remains unvalidated.

title: Embodied Sensorimotor Control
human_nms_modeling: conceptually couples neural controller, body mechanics, sensory feedback and environment
sensorimotor_control: defines a closed-loop explanatory framework rather than implementing one
rehabilitation_relevance: medium to high as a scientific framework
subject_specific_validation: none
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is a strong conceptual Embodied-AI paper, but not empirical evidence for a human NMS agent.

title: MyoSim
human_nms_modeling: efficient MuJoCo musculoskeletal and exoskeleton bodies
sensorimotor_control: supports closed-loop policy training in coupled body/device environments
subject_specific_validation: generic configurable models, not data-bound subjects
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It provides scalable physical embodiment for policy learning, while patient specificity and hardware validity remain external.

title: MyoSuite
human_nms_modeling: contact-rich muscle-actuated hand, arm and leg bodies
sensorimotor_control: agents learn tasks under weakness, fatigue and tendon-transfer perturbations
subject_specific_validation: no real subject binding
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: MyoSuite is a core NMS Embodied-AI benchmark; pathology parameters do not by themselves constitute patient validation.

title: MyoDex
human_nms_modeling: a simulated musculoskeletal hand
sensorimotor_control: a reusable policy prior accelerates new contact-rich actions
subject_specific_validation: no subject-specific validation
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It contributes transferable embodied motor priors, but transfer remains inside one simulator family.

title: MS-Human-700 full-body self model
human_nms_modeling: a 700-musculotendon-unit whole-body agent
sensorimotor_control: hierarchical representations enable locomotor policy learning
rehabilitation_relevance: medium as a whole-body disability/assistance substrate
subject_specific_validation: generic model only
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It expands the scale of NMS embodiment and control, but model size and self-model language do not establish human or patient validity.

title: MyoChallenge 2024
human_nms_modeling: standardized biological and bionic simulated limbs
sensorimotor_control: competition policies act in dexterity and agility environments
subject_specific_validation: no patient binding
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is strong community-level evidence about current embodied-control capability, while its scores remain simulator-defined.

title: OpenSense
human_nms_modeling: an OpenSim kinematic body driven by IMUs
sensorimotor_control: continuous observation updates pose, with no policy or action loop
subject_specific_validation: healthy subject calibration/validation only
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: OpenSense is an observation layer for embodiment; angle tracking alone is not embodied intelligence.

title: OpenCap
human_nms_modeling: an episodic OpenSim body reconstructed from smartphone video
sensorimotor_control: observation produces kinematics/dynamics without agent action
rehabilitation_relevance: high for remote assessment, not tested as adaptive rehabilitation
subject_specific_validation: subject-scaled models with population validation rather than persistent patient binding
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: OpenCap scales body-state acquisition; its embodied-AI value depends on later decision/control use.

title: User-generic ultrasound HMI
human_nms_modeling: muscle morphology as a control-relevant bodily signal
sensorimotor_control: decoded intent controls a virtual interaction loop
subject_specific_validation: user-generic and cross-user testing, not patient-specific mechanics
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It demonstrates embodied interfacing beyond EMG/IMU, but remains an intent sensor rather than a complete NMS agent.

title: Voluntary exoskeleton control via neuromechanical modeling
human_nms_modeling: a subject-specific EMG-driven NMS body model
sensorimotor_control: residual neural drive is converted online into multi-joint robot torque
subject_specific_validation: four healthy and three paresis participants with patient-specific models
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is one of the strongest human NMS embodied systems: neural state, personalized body model and physical action are closed, but evidence is short-term and lacks uncertainty or recovery outcomes.

title: Real-time NMS wrist-hand prosthesis control
human_nms_modeling: a subject-specific wrist–hand NMS model
sensorimotor_control: EMG-driven mechanics generate simultaneous physical prosthesis commands
rehabilitation_relevance: direct functional relevance, limited longitudinal evidence
subject_specific_validation: subject-specific real-time validation; cohort details incompletely accessible in this pass
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is a strong physics-constrained embodied interface, but long-term use, sensory feedback and patient function remain insufficiently tested.

title: Adaptive model-based control for soft arm exosuit
human_nms_modeling: an adaptive subject-specific biomechanical arm model
sensorimotor_control: voluntary effort and posture update assistance online
subject_specific_validation: healthy short-session subject adaptation
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is genuine physical embodied control; the unresolved issue is whether adaptation tracks physiology or merely compensates sensor/model drift.

title: NMS-modeling-based prostheses after SCI
human_nms_modeling: proposes a neural–muscle–skeletal prosthesis representation
sensorimotor_control: describes future bidirectional loops but implements none
subject_specific_validation: none in this paper
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is a strong research agenda but weak empirical Embodied-AI evidence.

title: Human-in-the-loop exoskeleton optimization
human_nms_modeling: no explicit NMS body state; physiology appears as a metabolic objective
sensorimotor_control: a physical human and exoskeleton jointly close an optimization loop
rehabilitation_relevance: medium; healthy assistance rather than rehabilitation
subject_specific_validation: individual optimization without mechanistic subject model
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is strong embodied adaptation evidence, but not human NMS embodied modeling because the internal body state is a black-box objective.

title: Real-world personalized exoskeleton assistance
human_nms_modeling: no mechanistic NMS representation
sensorimotor_control: online optimization adapts physical assistance during real-world walking
rehabilitation_relevance: medium; functional relevance without patient rehabilitation
subject_specific_validation: individual online optimization, mainly non-disabled users
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It sets a high bar for real-world embodiment and outcome validation while leaving neural–musculoskeletal state implicit.

title: DRL exoskeleton coupled to an MSK model
human_nms_modeling: a coupled musculoskeletal human and exoskeleton model
sensorimotor_control: policy acts in a perturbed locomotion environment
subject_specific_validation: generic/pathology-parameter variation without patient binding
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is genuine simulated embodied assistance, but no patient-conditioned model, hardware transfer or clinical endpoint is shown.

title: Patient-specific EMG-driven model for gait robots
human_nms_modeling: an EMG-driven person-specific gait model
sensorimotor_control: predicts torque offline without commanding a robot
subject_specific_validation: six adolescents with subject-specific models
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is a body-model baseline for human-inspired robotics, not an embodied control paper because the proposed robot loop is absent.

title: Muscle activation for robotic rehabilitation after SCI
human_nms_modeling: muscle activation is treated as a rehabilitation-relevant human state
sensorimotor_control: compares neural engagement across stimulation/training conditions without controlling a robot
human_robot_interaction: robotic-rehabilitation context but no closed HRI
rehabilitation_relevance: direct and high for defining outcomes
subject_specific_validation: SCI and healthy human validation, not a subject-specific NMS model
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It contributes a clinically meaningful embodiment target—voluntary muscle engagement—but not an embodied controller.

title: Online personalized exoskeleton assistance after stroke
human_nms_modeling: an online person-specific human–exoskeleton interaction model
sensorimotor_control: gait phase/torque estimation updates physical assistance in under a minute
assistive_control: validated assistive control with a stroke pilot
rehabilitation_relevance: direct, but clinical evidence is preliminary
subject_specific_validation: multi-user evaluation with only a single stroke case
overall_embodied_ai_assessment: It is among the closest patient-grounded embodied systems, but mechanistic NMS state, uncertainty and longitudinal rehabilitation evidence remain missing.
